# A synthetic report in the linux_ref mem.* shape, a deeper read than
# linux_ref.sh's: 28 HVS words - six identity/channel words and the 22 words
# of ch0's display list at +0x4000 - plus 7 pixelvalve1 words (this dump does
# not read pixelvalve0) and the two hd status words at +0x40 and +0x44.
# Generation C; the list is the two-plane 1280x720 form of
# driver/zephyr/lib/board/test/hvs6_dlist_mock.c (planes 1280x256 then
# 1280x464 at pitch 5120, closed by an end word), and the valve words are
# pv_timing_mock.c's 1080p60. The plane addresses in the list are buffer
# addresses; the decoder prints them only as offsets from the first plane's
# address, so the decoded output names no absolute address.
